control_flow.name: Condition
control_flow.description: Evaluates a boolean expression and routes to true/false branches.

fieldConfig.label: Expression
fieldConfig.description: Boolean expression to evaluate (e.g. $.data.amount > 100).

fieldConfig.label: True Branch Label
fieldConfig.description: Display label for the true branch.

fieldConfig.label: False Branch Label
fieldConfig.description: Display label for the false branch.

fieldConfig.label: Result
fieldConfig.description: The evaluated boolean result.

fieldConfig.label: Branch
fieldConfig.description: The branch taken: 'true' or 'false'.

control_flow.name: Switch
control_flow.description: Routes execution to one of several branches based on a value.

fieldConfig.label: Expression
fieldConfig.description: Expression whose value determines the branch.

fieldConfig.label: Cases
fieldConfig.description: Map of value to branch name (e.g. {"approved": "branch_a", "rejected": "branch_b"}).

fieldConfig.label: Default Branch
fieldConfig.description: Branch to take when no case matches.

fieldConfig.label: Evaluated Value
fieldConfig.description: The value that the expression evaluated to.

fieldConfig.label: Matched Case
fieldConfig.description: The case key that matched the evaluated value.

fieldConfig.label: Branch
fieldConfig.description: The branch name routed to.

control_flow.name: Loop
control_flow.description: Iterates over a collection or repeats until a condition is met.

fieldConfig.label: Loop Type
fieldConfig.description: How the loop iterates.

fieldConfig.label: Collection
fieldConfig.description: Expression pointing to the collection to iterate over.

fieldConfig.label: Max Iterations
fieldConfig.description: Maximum number of iterations (safety limit).

fieldConfig.label: Condition
fieldConfig.description: Boolean expression evaluated each iteration; loop continues while true.

fieldConfig.label: Counter Variable
fieldConfig.description: Name of the variable holding the current iteration index.

fieldConfig.label: Iteration Count
fieldConfig.description: Total number of iterations executed.

fieldConfig.label: Completed
fieldConfig.description: Whether the loop ran to completion (not broken early).

fieldConfig.label: Break Reason
fieldConfig.description: Reason the loop exited early, if applicable.

fieldConfig.label: Max Concurrency
fieldConfig.description: Maximum number of branches to run simultaneously (0 = unlimited).

fieldConfig.label: Failure Strategy
fieldConfig.description: How to handle branch failures.

fieldConfig.label: Branches Total
fieldConfig.description: Total number of parallel branches.

fieldConfig.label: Branches Completed
fieldConfig.description: Number of branches that completed successfully.

fieldConfig.label: Branches Failed
fieldConfig.description: Number of branches that failed.

fieldConfig.label: All Succeeded
fieldConfig.description: Whether all branches completed successfully.

control_flow.name: Merge
control_flow.description: Waits for all parallel branches to complete before continuing.

fieldConfig.label: Merge Strategy
fieldConfig.description: When to continue execution.

fieldConfig.label: Wait Count
fieldConfig.description: Number of branches to wait for (only for 'Wait N' strategy).

fieldConfig.label: Timeout (seconds)
fieldConfig.description: Maximum time to wait for branches before timing out.

fieldConfig.label: Branches Received
fieldConfig.description: Number of branches that reported in.

fieldConfig.label: Completed
fieldConfig.description: Whether the merge condition was satisfied.

fieldConfig.label: Timed Out
fieldConfig.description: Whether the merge timed out waiting for branches.

control_flow.name: Trigger
control_flow.description: Entry point that starts workflow execution on an event or schedule.

fieldConfig.label: Trigger Type
fieldConfig.description: How the workflow is triggered.

fieldConfig.label: Cron Schedule
fieldConfig.description: Cron expression for scheduled triggers (e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5').

fieldConfig.label: Event Topic
fieldConfig.description: Event topic to subscribe to.

fieldConfig.label: Event Filter
fieldConfig.description: Optional filter expression for incoming events.

fieldConfig.label: Webhook Path
fieldConfig.description: URL path segment for the webhook endpoint.

fieldConfig.label: Trigger Type
fieldConfig.description: The type of trigger that fired.

fieldConfig.label: Triggered At
fieldConfig.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the trigger fired.

fieldConfig.label: Trigger Payload
fieldConfig.description: Data payload from the trigger event.

fieldConfig.label: Correlation ID
fieldConfig.description: Unique identifier to correlate the trigger with external systems.

control_flow.name: Workflow
control_flow.description: Invokes another workflow as a sub-workflow.

fieldConfig.label: Workflow ID
fieldConfig.description: ID of the sub-workflow to invoke.

fieldConfig.label: Input Mapping
fieldConfig.description: Map parent data to sub-workflow inputs.

fieldConfig.label: Wait for Completion
fieldConfig.description: Whether to block until the sub-workflow finishes.

fieldConfig.label: Timeout (seconds)
fieldConfig.description: Maximum time to wait for sub-workflow completion.

fieldConfig.label: Sub-Run ID
fieldConfig.description: Run ID of the invoked sub-workflow.

fieldConfig.label: Sub-Workflow Status
fieldConfig.description: Final status of the sub-workflow run.

fieldConfig.label: Output Data
fieldConfig.description: Output data returned by the sub-workflow.

control_flow.name: Compute
control_flow.description: Performs in-process data transformation or computation.

fieldConfig.label: Expression
fieldConfig.description: The transformation expression to evaluate.

fieldConfig.label: Language
fieldConfig.description: Expression language to use.

fieldConfig.label: Input Data
fieldConfig.description: Optional explicit input data to transform (defaults to node input).

fieldConfig.label: Result
fieldConfig.description: The computed result of the expression.

fieldConfig.label: Execution Time (ms)
fieldConfig.description: Time taken to evaluate the expression in milliseconds.

control_flow.name: Group
control_flow.description: Visual grouping container for organizing related nodes. No execution semantics.

fieldConfig.label: Children
fieldConfig.description: List of node IDs that belong to this group.

fieldConfig.label: Group Label
fieldConfig.description: Display label for the group.

fieldConfig.label: Group Color
fieldConfig.description: Color for the group boundary (hex or CSS name).

worker.name: Request Worker
worker.description: Executes tasks via 'Request Worker'. Capabilities: Request Worker.execute.

fieldConfig.label: HTTP Method
fieldConfig.description: The HTTP method to use.

fieldConfig.label: URL
fieldConfig.description: The target URL for the HTTP request.

fieldConfig.label: Headers
fieldConfig.description: HTTP headers to include in the request.

fieldConfig.label: Query Parameters
fieldConfig.description: URL query parameters appended to the URL.

fieldConfig.label: Body Type
fieldConfig.description: The format of the request body.

fieldConfig.label: Request Body
fieldConfig.description: The request body. Can be a JSON object/array or a string.

fieldConfig.label: Body Fields
fieldConfig.description: Define structured fields for the request body.

fieldConfig.label: Timeout (seconds)
fieldConfig.description: Maximum time to wait for a response.

fieldConfig.label: Authentication Type
fieldConfig.description: The authentication method to use.

fieldConfig.label: Auth Token / API Key
fieldConfig.description: Bearer token or API key value.

fieldConfig.label: Username
fieldConfig.description: Username for Basic authentication.

fieldConfig.label: Password
fieldConfig.description: Password for Basic authentication.

fieldConfig.label: API Key Header Name
fieldConfig.description: Header name for API key authentication.

fieldConfig.label: Follow Redirects
fieldConfig.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects.

fieldConfig.label: Verify SSL
fieldConfig.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates.

fieldConfig.label: HTTP Status Code
fieldConfig.description: The response HTTP status code.

fieldConfig.label: Response Headers
fieldConfig.description: HTTP headers returned in the response.

fieldConfig.label: Response Body
fieldConfig.description: The response body. Parsed as JSON if content-type is application/json, otherwise returned as a string.

fieldConfig.label: Content-Type
fieldConfig.description: The Content-Type header from the response.

fieldConfig.label: Elapsed Time (ms)
fieldConfig.description: Time taken for the HTTP round-trip in milliseconds.

fieldConfig.label: Is Success
fieldConfig.description: True if the status code is 2xx.

fieldConfig.label: Final URL
fieldConfig.description: The final URL after following any redirects.

worker.name: Wait Worker
worker.description: Executes tasks via 'Wait Worker'. Capabilities: Wait Worker.execute.

fieldConfig.label: Wait Type
fieldConfig.description: The type of wait to perform.

fieldConfig.label: Duration (seconds)
fieldConfig.description: Number of seconds to wait. Used when wait_type is 'fixed_duration'.

fieldConfig.label: Duration (minutes)
fieldConfig.description: Number of minutes to wait. Added to duration_seconds.

fieldConfig.label: Wait Until (ISO 8601)
fieldConfig.description: Wait until this datetime. Format: ISO 8601 (e.g. '2025-06-01T12:00:00Z').

fieldConfig.label: Timeout (seconds)
fieldConfig.description: Maximum time to wait before timing out. 0 means no timeout.

fieldConfig.label: Reason
fieldConfig.description: Human-readable reason for the wait (e.g. 'Waiting for approval', 'Cool-down period').

checks.message: Reason must be 500 characters or fewer

fieldConfig.label: Wait Status
fieldConfig.description: Outcome of the wait operation.

fieldConfig.label: Wait Type Used
fieldConfig.description: The wait type that was executed.

fieldConfig.label: Started At
fieldConfig.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the wait started.

fieldConfig.label: Completed At
fieldConfig.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the wait finished.

fieldConfig.label: Actual Duration (seconds)
fieldConfig.description: How long the wait actually lasted.

fieldConfig.label: Reason
fieldConfig.description: The reason provided for the wait.

fieldConfig.label: Message
fieldConfig.description: Human-readable summary of the wait result.
